objective: Investigate one signal for the user's very-high-probability single-position net +30 percent objective; compare time-to-target with no fixed holding deadline. Annualized return is not this target.
priorResearch: Seven earlier development candidates and their results have been inspected. This is an adaptive new hypothesis on development data, not an independent out-of-sample test. The three-proposal draft is not three completed trials.
designSource: docs/signal-next-hypotheses-v1.json, first priority threeStageContractionBreakoutDraft; unchanged contraction and breakout constants, with exact clock/coverage/selection semantics made explicit before any real outcomes.

sample.source: Unchanged original local SH/SZ main-board development snapshot including its existing warmup; no new source selection or additional recovered security appended.
sample.warmup: Before 2022-01-01 bars provide indicator inputs only; emit no warmup signals. No state or pending pattern carries across dates because this is a stateless daily predicate.
sample.knownCoverageGap: Four historical membership snapshots contain 125 securities absent from this local universe. Only 56 now have supplementary history. They remain separate; this trial neither corrects survivor bias nor measures its direction or magnitude.

baseEligibility.implementation: Existing DailyScorer(..., pools_only=True)._qualified_universe on every development session, using identical legacy eligibility config.
baseEligibility.listingHistorySemantics: The frozen scorer requires at least 120 observed-history bars including prewindow observations; when a listing date exists it caps that count by elapsed calendar days since listing. This is not a claim of 120 independently verified listing calendar days.
baseEligibility.baseAmountWindow: Existing eligibility mean uses the last 20 observed bars including T (normally T-19..T); it is distinct from the new ranking measure. The detector separately requires 81 aligned complete sessions.
baseEligibility.unknownIdentityFields: Missing historic ST, membership, listing date or trade status remain unverified under the existing diagnostic fallback; current name/status do not fill those fields.
baseEligibility.knownRejection: Known delisted, not-listed, nonmember, historical ST, insufficient observed history or observed liquidity below the fixed gate rejects before signal evaluation. Missing/invalid required inputs remain unevaluable, not observed pattern failures.
baseEligibility.suspension: An explicit historical halt cannot trigger. An explicit halt with positive volume is contradictory and unevaluable unless an earlier known hard rejection already applies. Unexplained missing/zero volume never proves a halt.

pattern.priceBasis: Unadjusted series.bars OHLCV, never reference-adjusted series.signal_bars. This raw basis does not prove comparable corporate-action regimes.
pattern.clock: Exactly 81 aligned exchange-calendar slots T-80..T with known finite positive OHLCV and valid OHLC envelopes. Missing slots or required amounts are unevaluable. All timestamps end at T.
pattern.movingAverages: MA80_T is arithmetic statistics.mean of closes T-79..T. Previous MA80 is statistics.mean of closes T-80..T-1. Require C_T > MA80_T > previous MA80, strictly.
pattern.breakout: Require C_T > max(H from T-40..T-1) strictly and V_T / statistics.mean(V from T-40..T-1) >= 1.2. This is the original default trendBreakout price-volume predicate on raw prices.
pattern.rangeContraction: D_j=max(H in block j)/min(L in block j)-1. Require D_1 > D_2 > D_3 strictly and D_3 <= 0.08. All range comparisons use Decimal(str(raw price)) operands, with fixed Decimal precision 28, and Decimal('0.08') so decimal price boundaries are retained without a tuned epsilon. Log raw block maxima/minima and the comparison basis; floating displayed D values are not reused for these gates. Do not move segment boundaries or include T in any block.
pattern.volumeContraction: Require statistics.mean(V in block3) <= 0.70 * statistics.mean(V in block1), using the same Python numeric semantics as the base volume predicate. There is no tuned epsilon, rounding or parameter scan. The range gate separately accepts its decimal D_3=0.08 boundary.
pattern.rankingInputs: Require explicit finite positive raw amount for each aligned session T-20..T-1. Prior20MeanAmount is their arithmetic statistics.mean, without T's amount, fallback volume*price, future data or reference adjustment.
pattern.emission: Emit at T close when all gates pass. No retest, first-breakout restriction, cooldown, waiting state or position-aware raw trigger suppression. Every later date is evaluated independently.
pattern.actionEvidence: Keep corporate actions, historical identity and execution certification false. Empty factor/dividend responses are not absence evidence.

selection.ranking: All raw candidate signals at T ranked by prior20MeanAmount descending, then symbol ascending; score and rawScore equal this raw amount mean solely for event-tool compatibility.
selection.positionExclusion: First record complete raw ranks and Top5. Then the existing evaluator excludes same-symbol same-group events still active. No rank-six backfill. Exit at today's open releases the symbol for a new close signal.
selection.controls: Same-day base-eligible universe minus the strategy Top5, sorted by SHA256(original control seed:day:new candidate ID:symbol) then symbol. Request the Top5 count, retain pool shortfalls; control membership may include raw triggers below Top5.
selection.controlLimit: Descriptive comparison with independent active-event exclusion; dates need not remain paired, events are correlated, and controls are not randomized causal evidence.
selection.interpretation: Any result describes the complete contraction-plus-breakout-plus-ranking rule; it cannot isolate a causal contribution of contraction alone.

eventPolicy.entry: Freeze quantity at T close with existing fee/price-limit reserve and signal-volume cap. One next-exchange-session opening attempt under the unchanged SignalTargetStudy; no delayed replacement.
eventPolicy.execution: Reuse existing fees, slippage, T+1 sell lock, gates, full-position target exits and opening capacity proxies unchanged. Code/config are hashed in the protocol; daily prices do not certify actual auction fills.
eventPolicy.terminal: Unhit positions are observed through cutoff with marked outcomes and right-censoring; no forced sale, no inference that an unhit event can never succeed.
eventPolicy.knownEngineLimit: The reused gate conservatively blocks a resumption opening after a known preceding halt. This implementation limitation is not corrected within this fixed comparative trial.

audit.candidateLog: Every raw signal with all calculation features, exact contributing session windows, eligibility unknowns, rank and Top5 status, including nonselected and later active-suppressed signals.
audit.dailyCoverage: Evaluate every one of the 3141 symbols on each of 484 sessions. Mutually exclusive status/reason counts must sum to 1520244 evaluations; unknown required inputs must remain distinguishable from observed false conditions.
audit.selectionLog: Retain complete raw-ranked symbols, strategy Top5 and selected controls for every session, reconciled with candidates and selected signals. No arbitrary state-transition file is required for this stateless hypothesis.
audit.files: Hash protocol, original data identity, candidates, coverage, selections, signals, result and summary; a changed successful artifact refuses recomputation. Keep every failed attempt.
audit.cohorts: Mature cohorts are based on potential calendar followup, not early success. Report each horizon's denominator, missing-result bounds, unfilled entries, active suppression and insufficient followup. Distinct mature cohorts are not a single cumulative probability curve.
audit.risk: Append unchanged PathRiskStudy raw daily-low -10/-20 boundaries and target ordering without changing trades. Include entry-day lows, exclude later lows on target-opening exit day, preserve uncertain paths.
audit.dependence: Report distinct signal symbols and dates. Existing Wilson intervals assume independence and do not certify these overlapping events. Very high probability needs adequate separately justified independent/prospective validation, which this trial does not supply.
audit.preRun: Synthetic causal/threshold/ranking/execution/lifecycle tests and independent implementation review, followed by source/data/protocol freeze before the first real outcomes.
audit.postRun: Independently verify source hashes, candidate formulas from raw source, full counts, selection/control lineage, cohort arithmetic and event/path timing. No parameter or sample changes in response to this run.
